data.opportunityTitle: Distressed Cities Technical Assistance (DCTA) Program for Fiscal Years 2026 and 2027

agencyDetails.agencyName: Department of Housing and Urban Development

topAgencyDetails.agencyName: Department of Housing and Urban Development

forecast.forecastDesc:
The Distressed Cities Technical Assistance (DCTA) Program competitively awards funding to eligible applicants. If selected through this NOFO, you will deliver technical assistance (TA) to Units of General Local Government (UGLG) that serve communities of 50,000 or fewer people facing economic hardship. As an awardee, you will work in close consultation with HUD, and in coordination with other awardees, to help UGLG officials and staff better meet the needs of their communities. You should have the capacity to either:

  • Deliver TA across HUD's jurisdiction (Category N), or
  • Deliver TA to specific areas as defined by this NOFO (Category L).
forecast.agencyContactEmailDesc: All communication regarding this NOFO opportunity should be addressed to distressedcities@hud.gov
forecast.applicantEligibilityDesc: Individuals, foreign entities, and sole proprietorship organizations are not eligible to compete for, or receive, awards made under this announcement.
forecast.estApplicationResponseDateDesc: Electronically submitted applications must be submitted no later than 11:59 p.m., ET, on the listed application due date.
